en.bdb: Himself the enjoyer as well as the joy

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: aape bhukhaa hoi kai aap jai rasoiee|

en.bdb: He (the Lord) Himself posing to be hungry goes into the kitchen and cooks the food kneading in it all sorts of delights.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਾਇਦਾ ਰਸ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਸ ਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhojan aap banaidhaa ras vich ras goiee|

en.bdb: Himself eating and getting  satiated He showers praises on the dainty dishes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖਾਇ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: aape khai salaeh kai hoi tirapat samoiee|

en.bdb: He Himself is the delight as well as the delighted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਭੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: aape raseeaa aap ras ras rasanaa bhoiee|

en.bdb: He is the juice as well as the tongue which relishes its taste.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬੰਗੁ ਸਮੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhaataa bhugataa aap hai saraba(n)g samoiee|

en.bdb: He permeating through all, Himself is the giver as well as receiver.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh hoiee ||3||

en.bdb: Knowing the fact that He permeates among all, the Gurmukh feels immense pleasure.
